source: WPP Scangroup Plc audited summary financial results for the year ended 31 Dec 2025 (PwC, unmodified opinion dated 23 Apr 2026) | CRON 20261013: Net Finance Costs, Profit Before Tax, Net Profit and EPS filled for FY2025 and FY2024 from WPP Scangroup Plc Integrated Report and Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (audited by PwC, unmodified), consolidated statement of profit or loss printed page 49 and note 15 Loss per share printed page 74. Group column, Sh'000: interest income 125,994 and interest expense (30,053) FY2025, 260,827 and (54,813) FY2024; loss before tax (639,346) FY2025 and (426,680) FY2024; tax charge (74,327) FY2025 and (80,059) FY2024; loss for the year (713,673) FY2025 and (506,739) FY2024. Ties: loss before tax less the tax charge already stored in this file equals the loss for the year in both years. Net Finance Costs carries the printed interest expense on the same convention as the other NSE files here (the interest income line is printed separately and is not netted off). EPS is the printed basic and diluted loss per share of (1.61) Sh FY2025 and (1.17) Sh FY2024, struck on the loss attributable to shareholders of the holding company (696,672) over 432,156 thousand weighted average shares. Source URL https://cdn.wpp-scangroup.com/wppscangroupsite/pdf/2026/WPP-ANNUAL-REPORT-2025.pdf | CRON 20261014: H1 2026 column read from WPP Scangroup Plc unaudited summary consolidated statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (Kshs thousands read as absolute KES): gross profit 539,656; operating and administrative expenses 796,913; operating losses 257,257; interest income net of expense 28,136; other income 12,104; allowance for expected credit loss 23,268; foreign exchange loss 33,773; loss before tax 227,522; tax charge 26,492; loss for the period 254,014, of which attributable to shareholders 241,360 and non controlling interests 12,654; loss per share 0.56. The issuer summary begins at gross profit and prints no revenue or cost of sales line for the period, so those two rows stay empty. Ties: gross profit less operating and administrative expenses equals the printed operating loss 257,257, and loss before tax less the tax charge equals the printed loss for the period 254,014. Read by OCR of the published summary, which has no extractable text layer.
